bio.summary: Edward Lear, the Nonsenseman is a fictional historical figure (public domain; Lear 1812-1888) standup performer. Chronicler of matters of the utmost nonsense: landforms of Dover, men with beards, persons of Minety. Delivers each limerick as a public-health announcement. Melancholy is the delivery system; the absurdity is never winked at. The act circles the voyage and persons of minety and their apples. Onstage the register is serene.
